_meta.description: Tap to fly through endless obstacles in this addictive owl flying game. Unique graphics, simple mechanics, amazing soundtrack, and competitive leaderboard. Do you have what it takes?
_title: Wise Flyer - Can You Top the Leaderboard?
beautiful-distinctive-art-style.712389: Beautiful, distinctive art style featuring a charming owl character. Stand out visuals that make every flight memorable.
beautiful-unique-graphics-featuring.41cd: Beautiful unique graphics featuring an adorable owl, smooth gameplay, an amazing soundtrack, competitive leaderboard, and that perfect "just one more try" addictiveness. It's simple, fun, and incredibly hard to put down!
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
challenge-your-friends-head.43a4ee: Challenge your friends head-to-head through iMessage and GameCenter. Send attacks, defend your score, and prove who's the ultimate flyer.
compete-with-players-worldwide.5193da: Compete with players worldwide on the leaderboard. Climb the ranks and prove you're the wisest flyer of them all.
easy-to-learn-hard.7a4a1b: Easy to learn, hard to master. Just tap to flap and navigate through obstacles. Perfect for quick gaming sessions or extended play.
how-do-i-play.f07bc7: How do I play Wise Flyer?
immersive-music-and-satisfying.f0bb58: Immersive music and satisfying sound effects enhance every moment. The perfect audio backdrop for your flying adventure.
infinitely-scrolling-gameplay-means.c5b6: Infinitely scrolling gameplay means the challenge never ends. How far can you fly? Test your skills and push your limits.
inspired-by-the-classic.0a1528: Inspired by the classic bird flying game you know and love, Wise Flyer brings its own unique charm with beautiful owl graphics and smooth, addictive gameplay.
is-wise-flyer-similar.08e201: Is Wise Flyer similar to other bird games?
jump-right-into-the.b62243: Jump right into the action with no complex menus or tutorials. Perfect for quick gaming sessions whenever you have a moment.
simple-to-learn-challenging.9258cc: Simple to learn, challenging to master, impossible to put down
simply-tap-the-screen.e5f71a: Simply tap the screen to make the owl flap and fly upward. Release to let gravity bring you down. Navigate through obstacles by timing your taps carefully. It's easy to learn but challenging to master!
tap-to-fly-through.b265b8: Tap to fly through endless obstacles in this addictive owl flying game inspired by a popular bird classic. Featuring unique graphics, simple tap mechanics, endless scrolling gameplay, an amazing soundtrack, and a competitive leaderboard. Do you have what it takes to stay on top?
the-competition-is-fierce.d796b4: The competition is fierce, but the glory is worth it. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Wise Flyer and dominate the leaderboard?
the-game-and-attack.8f5441: The game and Attack-mode HUD now scale by the window, not the device — so a small iPad window renders perfectly in Split View, Stage Manager, and iPad windowing.
the-global-leaderboard-tracks.39934e: The global leaderboard tracks high scores from players around the world. Your best score is automatically submitted, and you can see where you rank against other players. Climb the ranks by improving your skills!
the-perfect-game-for.1af40a: The perfect game for commutes, waiting rooms, or any time you need a quick gaming fix. Pick it up for 30 seconds or 30 minutes—it's always ready when you are.
the-simple-tap-mechanic.47d4fc: The simple tap mechanic makes it easy to pick up but challenging to master. Navigate through obstacles, collect points, and see how far you can fly in this endless adventure.
think-you-re-good.653a07: Think you're good? Prove it on the global leaderboard. Compare your high scores with players from around the world and climb your way to the top.
window-friendly-flying-fairer.7f54ad: Window-friendly flying, fairer scores, and smoother ghosts
wise-flyer-is-inspired.fa95a1: Wise Flyer is inspired by the classic bird flying game genre but features unique graphics with a charming owl character, distinctive visual style, and its own personality. If you loved those games, you'll love this!
with-infinitely-scrolling-gameplay.099be: With infinitely scrolling gameplay and procedurally generated obstacles, no two flights are the same. Every session brings new challenges and opportunities to beat your high score.
yes-the-scrolling-is.f7335d: Yes! The scrolling is infinite and obstacles are continuously generated. The game only ends when you hit an obstacle. How far can you fly? The only limit is your skill!
yes-wise-flyer-can.52a69d: Yes! Wise Flyer can be played completely offline. Leaderboard features require an internet connection, but the core gameplay works anywhere, anytime.
your-local-best-score.16fb62: Your local best score is no longer overwritten when Game Center is off, ghost replays in Attack mode play back noticeably smoother, and leaderboards open through the latest Game Center experience.
